title: Bags, Cans, and Courage
subtitle: Henry clears the noisy porch one clatter at a time.

levels.title: Snack Bowl Snoop
levels.clue: Leo is sniffing Henry's snack bowl—and the porch breeze is picking up.

levels.title: The First Clatter
levels.clue: Cans rolled out of the bin. Match beside them so Henry can nudge them quiet.

levels.title: The Flapping Bag
levels.clue: A plastic bag flaps like a ghost. Henry shoos it away for Leo.

levels.title: Rattle and Roll
levels.clue: Some cans rattle twice before they settle down.

levels.title: Henry Stands Firm
levels.clue: Henry plants his paws between Leo and the noise.

levels.title: Back to the Bench
levels.clue: Leo darted under the bench. Henry follows the paw prints to him.

levels.title: A Gust of Bags
levels.clue: Whoosh! More bags tumble across the porch. Henry chases each one off.

levels.title: The Recycling Tumble
levels.clue: The whole bin tipped over. Henry clears the noisy path one can at a time.

levels.title: Almost Quiet
levels.clue: Only a few clatters left. Leo peeks out from behind Henry.

levels.title: Sharing the Snack
levels.clue: Quiet the last cans and bags, then Henry shares his snack with Leo.
